description: Usage in the current billing period, per bucket: seconds of standard testing, load testing, mapping, AI voice experience, mission testing and compliance testing; AI tokens (all, and the Quinn, digital testing and voice analysis parts); survey SMS segments; calls. periodStart and periodEnd are the billing period, which is not the calendar month. Figures are usage, never money. Use when: someone asks how much they have used this period. Owner or billing admin only; other roles get 403. Only a person signed in to the nopaque web app can call this (the in-app assistant); an API key is refused.
name: getWorkspaceUsageThisPeriod

outputSchema.description:
Usage in the current billing period, per bucket. From auth's
`GET .../billing/v2/usage`. Seconds, tokens, SMS segments and calls,
never money. `included` and `left` appear only when auth reports an
allowance for the bucket (it does not today).

periodEnd.description: End of the billing period (when it renews).

title: Get Usage This Billing Period
